title: Projektetage Tile Fullscreen
description: Fix split tile fullscreen on projektetage catalogue slides: pressing fullscreen on a tile does not expand it to slide fullscreen.
summary: Enlarged uniform interactive fullscreen frame from 45%×42.5% to 90%×85% slide space (5% / 7.5% margins). Still identical for figure, video, pdf, and split tiles; much closer to immersive fullscreen than the prior midpoint between catalogue thumb and video.
